thread:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to pick packaging for FastLane priority before Friday. Two options: burst tokens (PAYG) or commit slabs (monthly). Need default breach behavior, contract exhibit bullets, and the pilot plan.

morgan: slabs = predictable ARR. tokens = flexible for customers. tradeoff: complexity vs stickiness.

ajay: technical note: tokens map to ms of priority CPU/KV cache. rough mapping: 1 token ~50ms priority processing. slabs reserve N priority slots.

sophia: Private/Dedicated customers: can't assume preemption unless they opt-in in contract. compliance hit otherwise.

kevin: Ops: tokens need realtime counters and reconciliation; estimate ~8 dev-days. slabs enforcement is simpler (~2 dev-days).

elainE (typo): please don't call me elainE ; )

elainE: noted. editing.

elainE: actually meant elaine: SLOs we should measure for canary: p95/p99 tail improvement, priority preempt events, and fallback counts.

ajay: Canary checklist suggestion: 3 pilots (chat, embeddings, ingest), verify billing reconciliation within 1%, per-route toggle works, and monitor priority latency delta.

morgan: Pricing thoughts: price tokens at ~+20% vs slab marginal to nudge commitments. slabs offered as 30/90/365 day terms.

jennifer-legal: Contract items: tokens exhibit (token price, auto-topup opt-in, customer-controlled hard-spend cap). slabs exhibit (monthly fee, term, overage rate, cancellation window).

sophia: For private installs add explicit checkbox: "allow preemption of local capacity for FastLane". default = unchecked.

kevin: Overflow policy - two choices: immediate degrade to standard lane (fast fail/fallback header) or queue until slot frees. Ops favours immediate degrade by default.

morgan: agree immediate degrade default, offer queueing as opt-in. avoids long tail latency surprises.

ajay: Need per-route toggle in API + Console (boolean + allocation size). making per-route default = off.

elainE: Checklist (product/eng/finance/legal/ops): finalize SLOs + UI mock, prototype enforcement for both models, ARR modelling, draft contract exhibits, shortlist pilots.

kevin: Eng will scope router changes and schedule an extra oncall for canary.

ajay: I'll spin up a small in-memory token ledger prototype and run reconciliation tests by Wed.

morgan: Finance will model ARR sensitivity and churn impact by EOD Fri.

sophia: I'll collect 3 pilot customers (1 continuous, 2 bursty) and propose dates.

jennifer-legal: default legal positions: no rollover of tokens at launch, no refunds on early cancel for slabs (standard prorate discussion), auto-renew unless canceled 7 days prior.

elainE: Decisions to confirm before locking: min slab unit size (propose 1k slot-hours), token rollover policy (no-roll for launch), default breach behavior (degrade).

morgan: +1 on proposals.

ajay: +1. will also add signed reconciliation batches for ledger audit trail.

ops-bot: Canary window reserved 2024-06-12 09:00-12:00 UTC

kevin: noted, will add rotation.

elainE: thanks everyone — I'll consolidate into a short spec + contract draft and circulate. react with :white_check_mark: when you accept assigned items.
